title: Original-language metadata
description: Show artist and title in their original script when the map provides it; otherwise the romanised fields are used.

title: Star rating
description: Star rating with the active mods applied.

title: Mods
description: Selected mods in song select, played mods during play and on results. Hidden when no mods are active.

title: Long titles
description: marquee scrolls a line that does not fit, pausing at both ends; truncate ends it with an ellipsis. Lines that fit never move.

title: Alignment
description: Where the bar sits inside the 1920 px wide source; it grows away from that edge.

title: Maximum width / px
description: Widest the bar may grow before long titles scroll or truncate; clamped to 320–1896 px.
